subject: Packaging options: step-down with feature retention and prorated billing
messages:
From: Sara Holt <sara.holt@clearquest.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re-evaluating our plan — usage drop and preserving a couple features

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note from our side: our usage has fallen about 55% since the pilot peak (see attached usage_report_q1.csv). Procurement asked whether we can step down one tier to reduce monthly spend but keep two things that are critical for our workflows: (1) priority GPU routing for low-latency inference, and (2) the KV/prefix caching for our session-based flows.

We signed an annual contract that rolls over Oct 1. Before we engage procurement, can you outline:
- whether a one-tier step-down is possible mid-term while preserving those features as entitlements or billable addons
- how you handle prorated billing and any crediting for the difference this quarter
- any minimum commitment or timeframe to avoid losing the grandfathered feature pricing

We want to be practical — we may not need the same throughput, but we can't lose the latency/fallback guarantees. Also share what a conservative discount looks like if we commit to a 6-month usage floor.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Holt
Director, Product Operations
ClearQuest Health
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Holt <sara.holt@clearquest.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Re-evaluating our plan — usage drop and preserving a couple features

Sara — thanks for the clear numbers and the attachment. Quick summary of viable paths below (high level), then I put some asks for procurement redlines.

Options we can offer mid-contract:
1) Step down to Compact tier with Priority Routing & KV cache kept as paid add-ons. Prorated billing applies for the remainder of the current billing month; we issue a credit for unused throughput if you downgrade immediately (example calc below).
2) Maintain current tier but apply a temporary seat/throughput carve (60-day pilot) + 10-15% usage discount if you commit to a 6-month minimum usage floor.
3) Full step-down + 6-month commit with a concession on feature pricing (we can cap Priority Routing at a fixed monthly addon price rather than per-token premium).

Prorate example (ballpark):
- Current monthly list: $18,500
- Compact tier list: $11,000
- If downgrade today (mid-billing), you'd get a pro-rated credit ~ $3,800 for unused portion; new month billed at Compact rate. Exact numbers come from the billing cycle boundary — we can send a precise invoice once procurement confirms effective date.

Policy notes:
- Priority Routing is an entitlement that we can preserve as an addon at the current grandfathered rate for up to 6 months with a signed amendment. Longer-term pricing reverts to standard addon rates unless you take a reserved capacity commit.
- KV/prefix caching can be preserved if you maintain session retention settings; if retention drops below our minimum cache window we need to re-evaluate performance guarantees.

Next steps I propose:
- Ben: can you confirm the discount ladder we can approve (6-month commit vs 12-month)?
- Lauren: legal/ops — any constraints on preserving grandfathered addon pricing in an amendment?
- Sara: if you can share the procurement target date (and whether they require PO before DocuSign), I’ll pull a redline and a short SOW.

Attached: usage_report_q1.csv (from Sara). I’ll prepare a short summary quote once Ben confirms concession ranges.

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: ClearQuest concession ranges

Kim / Lauren — quick internal note on concession authority and suggested offer:
- Approve up to 15% discount off list for a 6-month committed usage floor (non-refundable).
- Approve cap on Priority Routing addon of $2,500/month (flat) for the 6-month period instead of per-token premium, provided they step down tiers to Compact.
- KV cache: should remain a configurable addon; we can offer a 3-month grandfather at current rate, then revert.

If procurement wants a longer commitment (12 months) we can extend discount to 22% and offer a 1-month free trial of dedicated burst capacity (subject to capacity).

Lauren — can you confirm legal signoff on a 6-month amendment that preserves addon pricing? Otherwise we need to push a clause that it is subject to capacity/price review after 90 days.

Ben
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Holt <sara.holt@clearquest.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Re-evaluating our plan — proposed amendment and next steps

Sara — looping you in with the approved internal concession. Summary of proposed amendment (attached as current_contract_redline.pdf):
- Move ClearQuest from Current Tier -> Compact Tier effective Aug 1, 2026 (prorate applies for July).
- Preserve Priority Routing at a capped $2,500/month for 6 months.
- Preserve KV/prefix caching at current rate for 3 months; we will re-evaluate based on average session retention and cache hit rate.
- Apply a 15% discount to Compact-tier list for a 6-month committed usage floor.

Docs & process:
- I’ve attached a redline (current_contract_redline.pdf) for legal review. If that looks good, we’ll send a short amendment + SOW through DocuSign for signature.
- We can generate the prorated invoice once you confirm Aug 1 effective date; procurement can either send a PO or we’ll accept DocuSign signature as agreement and follow up with an invoice.

If you want to hold Priority Routing at the grandfathered rate beyond 6 months, we’d need a 12-month commit to the Compact tier (22% discount instead of 15%).

Next steps: Sara, can you confirm procurement’s preferred flow (PO first vs DocuSign) and whether you want the amendment dated Aug 1?

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Legal Operations | Redwood Inference

Thanks, Lauren — this looks workable. ClearQuest will:
- Accept Compact Tier effective Aug 1, with prorated changes applied for July.
- Sign the 6-month commitment amendment at 15% discount.
- Accept Priority Routing capped at $2,500/month for the 6-month term.

Procurement prefers DocuSign-first (they route faster). Please send the amendment + SOW and we’ll get it turned around. Also please include the prorated invoice so I can attach it to the DocuSign packet.

I’ll loop in procurement (cc’d) once you send the DocuSign link.

Best,
Sara Holt
Director, Product Operations
ClearQuest Health
